notes.title: GARRISON: ARCHANGEL FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31962666/8dba6db3a0ccf5b921a1ca598c335b003e7f45fd.png[/img]

[h1]After 3 years in development, Garrison: Archangel is finally fully released! [/h1]

The epic, high-speed, customizable mecha fighting game Garrison: Archangel launches today!

We'd like to thank all our supporters and players who've stuck with us up until this point. We couldn't have come this far without all of you!

[h3][b]As a special bonus, we'll be having a special 25% OFF Launch Discount![/b]
[/h3]

We hope you enjoy the game. If you do, please tell your friends and Family about Garrison: Archangel!


[h2]What Now?[/h2]

Though any major developments and updates will cease in the foreseeable future, our Development Team will continue to fix remaining bugs and adjust any mechanics that aren't working as designed. We will be around to listen to feedback and any bug reports from our player and community, just like we had been doing in Early Access.

We suggest joining our community [url=https://discord.gg/DD4QaqV ]Discord[/url] where you can talk with the devs and other players of the game. This will also help you find other players to fight in multiplayer via steam remote play. Occasionally, community activities like design contests and content creation drives are also hosted there, so don't miss out on the fun!

For any further news and announcements, we also have social media channels such as [url=https://www.facebook.com/Garrison.Archangel/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Play_Archangel]Twitter[/url] accounts. Where we also share interesting videos, articles and content about the game.

Our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfpgJywWI0duZUAaeffOLLA]YouTube[/url] channel hosts videos of our game's development, as well as trailers and recordings of prior contests and tournaments.

Once again, thank you for supporting Garrison: Archangel, and see you in the Arena!

notes.title: Free Demo Update
notes.notes:
The available Free Demo version of the game in the store front received an update after a long while. This is to match the recent major changes that have been made in the last year. These updates include a lot of engine optimizations, better visuals, and new gameplay elements. 

As it is just a demo, there are still only limited parts and modes to play with, but these will give you a taste of the content available in the full version. You should be able to play with a friend with Steam Remote Play Together too.

Join the Early Access to enjoy the Single Player campaign, more unique Archangel Frames, more unique Weapons, alternate skins for Frames and Weapons, more Stages, and more Custom Game Modes. We also have a Preview branch that offers weekly updates for testing.

notes.title: FEBRUARY PRE-BALANCE PATCH - UPDATE 0.18.5
notes.notes:
Thanks for joining us in 2019. Here are the new internal system updates before we move into balance patches at the end of February.


[h1][b]Movement System Updates[/b][/h1]

With the update to the boost system and with the various mobility options now present in the game, we've upped the multiplier modifier for backward and sideward movement, which had been previously clamped at 50% and 75% respectively. They now both operate at 80% of forward movement speed, giving a higher overall sense of mobility for all.

In addition, held weapons such as machineguns, missiles and other rapid fire weapons, now disable gravity while in use. The exception to this rule are shields. While held, these rapid weapons do not allow for boost regeneration. Shields on the other hand, allow for both stability and boost regeneration.

[h1][b]Boost System (Experimental): Flight Mode[/b][/h1]

We introduced a new boost movement system while unlocked, called Flight Mode. It has a bit of startup, and quickly drains boost and stability, but allows the player to move forward at a sustained high speed. It immediately ends as soon as you lock on to a target.

This feature was made for long distance travelling in preparation for the upcoming missions over large maps.

[h1][b]Visual Updates[/b][/h1]

There are several visual updates, from animation layering for held weapons like firearms and shields, to UI updates with trackers for multiple enemy, allied and objective targets. We also made melee weapon trails a bit more flashy to approach the rule of cool anime look we set out to do. 

In addition, new camera and graphic settings are available for players who want a different look at the game. Try out the over-the-shoulder camera setting in the gameplay options!


[h1][b]AI and Horde updates[/b][/h1]

The AI has been tweaked in preparation for the coming mission modes, and some of these changes can already be seen in horde mode and the existing AI combatants in the various game modes (arcade, custom game, etc).

Though these changes are minor, there's quite a bit of them. We suggest playing the AI yourselves to feel the changes for yourself.

[h1][b]Engine Updates[/b][/h1]

Garrison: Archangel runs in Unity, and much of the development in January was spent porting and updating new features to Unity 2018.3. For this reason, we also addressed many bugs and refactored many existing systems. Since each individual change is minor, it is best to refer to the detailed list below.



[h1][b]Changelog List[/b][/h1]

Includes changes from v0.18.0 up to v0.18.5

[b]New Mechanics and Features[/b]
- New Movement: Flight Boost - Increased Boost speed used for traversal when no targets are locked. Does not overload Boost meter, but the stronger acceleration drains Stability. Forward movement only, no vertical or side movement.
- New settings : Added new SHOULDER camera offset in Gameplay Options.
- New Alternates/Cosmetics: Weapon skins for RANGER, WESPE, MOLNIYA, DRAGOON, EMANCIPATOR, UHLAN,  TATZELWURM, POPIGAI and YULONG

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
- Sideward movement speed while boosting increased to 80% from 75%.
- Backward movement speed while boosting increased to 80% from 50%.
- Input buffer now allows repeat inputs to extend the timer, and uses the last input when triggering. This does not prevent late single inputs from expiring.
- Camera offsets now adjust to make tilting upwards more comfortable.
- Adjusted AI parameters to lessen random jumping.
- Horde Grunt enemies now have reduced mobility.
- Held Attacks now also disable Gravity. Affected weapons include Autoguns, Missiles, Cannons.
- Reduced Flinch Cancel input restriction from 6 frames to 2 frames.

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Garrison: Archangel Public Update v0.17.2
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays from the Garrison: Archangel staff! This is the December 2018 Public Update to Garrison: Archangel.

[h1][b]Stability System Rework[/b][/h1]

The stability system has been reworked to become a more straightforward stat. The value presented on the stability stat now purely refers to the amount of stability damage one can take before flinching, a state now formally called 'Vulnerability'. 

This means archangels with higher stability can resist more damage before being stunned or flinched, regardless of their load values.


[h1][b]New System : Vulnerability[/b][/h1]

Vulnerability is a state in which an Archangel becomes susceptible to getting stunned or flinching from attacks that deal at least one point of stability damage. After a certain amount of stability damage is dealt during this state, Archangels are destabilized. 

This state is represented by the red portion of the stability bar on the HUD. Its value (the amount of stability damage one can take in this state before being destabilized) is modified by an Archangel's load percentage.

During this state, Archangels also suffer from a penalty to dodge cancel, which are called vulnerable dodge cancels. Archangels in this state also lose their passive deflection bonuses until they regain at least one stability point.


[h1][b]Boost System Rework[/b][/h1]

The boost system has also been overhauled. 

First, All types of Dodging now cause a longer pause before boost can be regenerated. Boosting and Flight no longer have this pause. 

Second, Dodge now has three formal types: 
Normal Dodge - which is dodging while neutral (not in the middle of any animation).
Dodge Cancel - which is dodging while in the middle of an animation and not in the vulnerable state.  This costs 1.5x the normal dodge costs.
Vulnerable Dodge Cancel (V.Dodge Cancel) - which is any dodge cancel performed during the vulnerable state. This costs 3x the normal dodge costs.

Third, a new stat called 'Boost Regeneration' has been introduced and shown in the garage stat list. It determines how fast an Archangel regains Boost. It is linked to the Speed Stat. 


[h1][b]New Weapon : Star Gauntlet[/b][/h1]

The Archangel Arms Concept Competition 2018 winner finally makes its public debut! This giant fist offers a wide variety of different attacks with different movements and options! It's secondary ability is 'Charge' - which allows it to power up its forward melee attack, transforming it into different attacks depending on the charge level!

Check it out!


[h1][b]New Maps[/b][/h1]

Two new maps, Riocorte Dam and the Solar Farm have been added. These are maps planned to be used for single-player campaigns that take place on the planet Baja Secunda, and are thus works in progress! Please expect more updates for them soon!


[h1][b]Changelog List[/b][/h1]

Includes changes from v0.17.0 up to v0.17.2

[b]New Items and Features[/b]
New Weapon: STAR GAUNTLET
Added Map: SOLAR FARM (HAZARD).
Added Map: RIOCORTE DAM (HAZARD).

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
Dodge will now delay Boost Regeneration for 0.6s (from 0.3s).
Boost Movement will now delay Boost Regeneration for 0.0s (from 0.3s).
Actions while Boost Regeneration is delayed will now reset the timer to 0.3s,
instead of pausing the timer.
Reworked Stability and Vulnerability (was Stability Threshold) calculations.
Being Parried will force the attacker to be Vulnerable.
Vulnerable state now ignores Deflection passives.
GRAVITIC ENHANCEMENT flat Stability bonus reduced to 100.
SHIELDS raising now starts the Blocking state instead of activating only after perfect guard.
Boost Movement is now instant.
Removed 0.25s delay when holding the button before Boosting.
Improved camera alignment to global up vector.
Improved AI Dodge management.


[b]Updates[/b]
Updated: Visual effects on mechs when using different cancel types.
Updated: Boost bar color to reflect boost states.

Hi! This weekly update introduces three new weapons to the game! The full buglist is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/682450/announcements/detail/1681414719749604460]here[/url].

[b]New Hand Weapon : LABRYS GIGANTAS![/b]
The new weapon is a giant axe that deals massive and quick damage but suffers from a lack of mobility and slow recovery. However, it can charge up by holding down its special command, allowing for various types of projectiles to be fired depending on the level attained!

[b]New Shoulder Weapons : TRAILBLAZER and ORTHRUS![/b]
The new shoulder weapons are the Trailblazer Thrusters and the Orthrus Scatterguns! The Trailblazer grants passive forward boost bonuses and a quick charge maneuver, while the Orthrus essentially consists of two shoulder-mounted shotguns! More shoulder part options!

[b]New Presets and Updated Presets![/b]
A lot has changed over the past iterations of the game. We have updated certain presets but found the rest of the roster lacking and obsolete. So most of the roster, with the exception of the champion builds, have been changed. We also added two new presets, made by members of the Garrison: Archangel team who want Archangels in the canon to represent their true (chuuni) self : 'SSS-CRIMSON.TRIGGER' and 'RUDE BOI'.

[b]Various Optimizations![/b]
We've done some optimizations in game that allow lower-end machines to run the game smoothly. We hope you guys enjoy a smoother experience as you play the game!

[b]Music List Update![/b]
We've decided all our songs to the custom game music list, including several new tracks: Blood-tinged Heaven, ARCHANGEL ~Shiny Groove~, and Simulacrum of Civility. They have been featured in our various videos on youtube [strike]as well as our anime trailer[/strike]. We've also returned Woeful Sky (Menu theme) and Soliloquy of Restless Dream (Garage theme) to the selectable music list as per request.

[b]Horde Voice Update![/b]
We've added a third batch of voices from our volunteers to horde mode! Now you kill less Paolores when you play! Thank you to Elosacle, Vol Ventura, and Maple from our Discord for contributing their voices! You can submit your own voices by following these instructions! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/682450/discussions/0/1694922526902941453/]here![/url]

[b]Fashion Fight is over![/b]
Fashion Fight is over! Stay tuned for our announcements over the weekend for the winners! As per popular request we have decided to include all three finalists in our next update!

[b]Development continues![/b]
Our plans are outlined in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791461484074/announcements/detail/1648761723381698597]Archangel Announcements Issue[/url] released in the first week of June. Next week, we will make a new announcement post for our plans for July!

[b]STEAM SUMMER SALE![/b]
Until July 6, Garrison: Archangel will have a 10% discount as part of the Summer Steam Sale! Get your friends and family to try the game today!

Hi! This update will contain the second balance update. The full patch notes can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/682450/announcements/detail/2504443199098220894]here[/url].

[b]Destabilize and Burst Mechanic Changes[/b]
After taking feedback from various players, we've decided to update the destabilize and burst mechanics introduced in v0.2.0. 

In case you are not aware, when you get detabilized, you get thrown down into the ground. During this time, your Archangel will enter a series of phases:

[list]
[*] In the first phase, your Archangel is completely invulnerable. You are able to dodge away from this state but your stability and boost gauge will not be recovered.
[*] In the second phase, your Archangel immediately recovers its stability and boost gauge. During this phase, you can either dodge away or input an attack command. This will cause a "burst" that will knock down enemies within radius. However, once you start this animation, you are completely vulnerable.
[*] In the last phase, if you did not wake up during the second phase, you will automatically wake up. However, you are invulnerable during the whole animation.
[/list]

In this new update, we have changed this process:

[list]
[*] Firstly, the burst mechanic is now completely removed.
[*] During the first phase, you are completely invulnerable. You can still dodge during this phase but your Archangel's stability and boost gauge will not be recovered.
[*] In the second phase, your Archangel immediately recovers its stability and boost gauge. However, if you were inputting a direction (not attack) during the start of this phase, you will quickly wake up completely invulnerable.
[*] If you did not wake up in the second phase, you will remain invulnerable in the ground for the next 2 seconds. The moment you input a direction, however, you will wake up vulnerable to attacks.
[*] If you did not do anything while knocked down, you will eventually wake up vulnerable to attacks.
[/list]

We thought that the burst mechanic was so strong that no one even dared to go near someone who is knocked down. We hope that this mechanics change improve everyone's gameplay experience.

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
As stated, this update contains the second balance changes across most weapons in the game. Here's a short summary of the changes:

[list]
[*] MAGNUM BARRETTE melee attacks have been improved.
[*] BLUTREITER scythe form stability damage has been adjusted.

[*] DRAGOON SG fires much faster.
[*] Both MOLNIYA SMG and DRAGOON SG has reduced ammo.

[/list]

[b]Development continues! [/b]
